_comment: 1Click /v0/quote response for the CLOSE leg (SOL→ZEC, EXACT_INPUT). Hand-authored HTTP fixture for tests/trade-close.test.mjs. amountIn is lamports (SOL); amountOut/minAmountOut are zats (ZEC). The rate 2400000 zats / 120000000 lamports = 0.02 zats/lamport is what feeCloseZats() uses to state the close fee in ZEC.
